Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MDU Rohtak Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for MDU Rohtak Research Assistant Recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 04 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Research Assistant post announced by Maharshi Dayanand University Rohtak.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential qualifications required for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MFA in Painting or M.A in History with a minimum of 55% marks, along with NET/JRF/M.Phil./Ph.D. qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 25,000.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job opening?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Maharshi Dayanand University Rohtak, Haryana.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the Research Assistant position is a contractual appointment.
